keyEvents.text: Goal! Orlando City SC 1, New England Revolution 0. Braian Ojeda (Orlando City SC) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner following a corner.
Substitution, Orlando City SC. Adrián Marín replaces Wilder Cartagena.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Joshua Wynder replaces Ethan Kohler.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Alhassan Yusuf replaces Dor Turgeman.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Brooklyn Raines replaces Carles Gil.
Substitution, Orlando City SC. Joran Gerbet replaces Eduard Atuesta.
Substitution, Orlando City SC. Daryl Dike replaces Marco Pasalic.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Diego Fagúndez replaces Matt Polster.
Substitution, Orlando City SC. Griffin Dorsey replaces Martín Ojeda.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Marcos Zambrano replaces Jackson Yueill.
Maxime Crépeau (Orlando City SC) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Orlando City SC 1, New England Revolution 0.
